vocabulary.description: Types and relations used, with their definitions.

name.description: Name in the language of the author.

direction.description: Relations: "toParent" reads "child RELATION parent" (default); "toChild" reads "parent RELATION child".

childType.description: Relations: type given to an element connected by this relation.

function.description: Relations: function of the connected element in an argument map.

style.description: tldraw style (geo, color, fill, dash, size, font, arrowheads); custom entries only.

items.description: An element type or relation used in the map.

id.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

text.description: Text shown in the box (plain text; line breaks allowed).

type.description: Element type (what the element is): statement, belief (assumption), fact, concept, distinction, question, problem, example, quote, or a custom type from `vocabulary`. Omitted: the type given by the relation (its `childType`), or none.

parent.description: Parent element in a tree. Omitted: the element is a root (or stands alone).

relation.description: Relation that connects the element to its parent (supports, objects, refutes, answers, explains, implies, presupposes, illustrates, defines, raises, distinguishes, opposes, relates, or a custom relation). Most relations read "element RELATION parent" ("the premise supports the thesis"); those with direction "toChild" in the vocabulary read "parent RELATION element" (implies, presupposes, raises). Omitted: a plain branch (mind map).

reasoning.description: Type of reasoning of the relation to the parent (mostly for supports and objects).

side.description: Trees with direction "both": side of a child of the root.

modality.description: Statements and assumptions: descriptive (how things are) or prescriptive (how things ought to be).

note.description: Longer development (Markdown), shown beside the diagram on demand.

folded.description: Branch folded at the start of the presentation.

origin.description: Generated from a source: stated in the text, or reconstructed by the analysis (an implicit assumption, a link left unsaid).

excerpt.description: Generated from a source: the passage it comes from, quoted verbatim.

function.description: Read-only, derived: function of the element in an argument map (Objection, Justification…). Ignored on import.

tree.description: On a root: the tree it starts.

kind.description: argument: argument map (relations give functions and colors); mindmap: plain tree.

direction.description: Direction in which the tree opens. Default: right.

elements.description: Parents come before their children; siblings are in display order.

id.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

from.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

to.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

relation.description: Reads "from RELATION to". Omitted: a plain arrow.

label.description: Text of a plain arrow (without relation).

items.description: An arrow between two elements outside the trees (a cross-link).

id.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

kind.description: tldraw shape type (text, frame, image, draw…).

items.description: Other shape of the diagram, given as context (read-only: ignored on import).

sequence.description: Progressive presentation. An element that no step shows is visible from the start, but only while its parent is visible: showing a thesis shows its whole tree, except what later steps show.

narration.description: Text shown to the audience beside the diagram (Markdown).

camera.description: follow (default): frame what the step shows; overview: the whole visible diagram; keep: do not move.

do.description: show, hide, dim, undim: lasting; highlight, focus (dims everything else), note (shows the note of the element): this step only; fold, unfold: a tree branch.

items.description: Short identifier, unique in the map (elements, links and other shapes share one namespace).

effect.description: show: entrance effect. Omitted: the box rises (fades in for a root) and the arrow to its parent is drawn.

part.description: Elements: only the box (node) or only the arrow to its parent (edge). Omitted: both.

description: An Unveilboard diagram: elements (boxes), trees, cross-links and presentation sequence.
